<!-- Paste the link to the Jira or GitHub issue or otherwise describe / point to where this change is coming from. -->

## 📔 Objective

Incorrect read only connection string on development self-hosted environment.

This bug is reproduced during selfHostedOverride, which is normally only the case for Bitwarden Developers environments https://github.com/bitwarden/server/blob/ae9bb427a16ff2ff5d1ba3b62101ad7e55bec02e/src/SharedWeb/Utilities/ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs#L582 and when read-only connection string is not explicit set.

Explanation:
The first time the GlobalSettings is read, both `ConnectionString` and then `ReadOnlyConnectionString` setters are called. For the read-only connection string setter, since there is no value, it will be taken from the getter, which is the `ConnectionString`.
The second time the GlobalSettings is read, the `ConnectionString` is overriden to self-hosted connection string. For the `ReadOnlyConnectionString` setter, since the value is not provided, it will be taken from the getter. But since we already store it in `_readOnlyConnectionString`, we return the first `ConnectionString` and not the second one `ConnectionString`.

The fix is to reset the `ReadOnlyConnectionString` stored value, every time the `ConnectionString` changes.

1) Install hr

ValueError: malformed node or string on line 1: <ast.Name object at 0x7333bacc>

https://github.com/odoo/odoo/blob/b070f9a4aa179799e3412d18b8faba07349bbf7b/addons/hr/models/hr_department.py#L147-L153

The domain in the action was modified from the below commit recently, https://github.com/odoo/odoo/pull/193572/commits/c2243abca397ab6622ec85e6fe6adbfef0d7c47b

body:
**What problem does this PR solve?**:

We changed the file layout from 2.13 to 2.14 which causes flux to delete and recreate the traefik HelmRelease which might cause some downtime during upgrades. Updating the file structure to ensure HelmRelease is not deleted during upgrades.

in v2.13 we had this file layout :
```
./services/traefik/<version>/treafik.yaml
```
where traefik.yaml contained an HelmRelease, Ingress record and a bunch of rbac stuff.

In v2.14 we refactored the layout to
```
./services/treafik/<version>/traefik.yaml # This is now a flux kustomization
./services/treafik/<version>/traefik/traefik.yaml # This is a new file containing the old helm release and rbac stuff.
```
Because of this restructure, when flux upgrades the AppDeployment, it removes the HelmRelease and creates a new Flux Kustomization. This flux kustomization eventually creates the HelmRelease but this eventually could be few seconds or a few minutes but more importantly, it results in the deletion of the HelmRelease resource.

body:
This MR adds a step to directly support multimodal RAG with S3 as the storage engine. There is a new class, `MultiModalRetriever` that takes in a MongoDB client, an S3 client, and a Voyage AI client to establish a direct embedding and vector search on PDF/Image files, as well as text. 

Clients can call the `mm_embed` function to directly calculate and store an embedding on their files stored in S3. When they call the `mm_query` function the mongo vector search results will be enriched with the S3 path data. That way users don't need to do any additional preprocessing (text or image extraction, for ex) on PDFs or images before creating embeddings.

- [x] establish image and pdf support from S3 with metadata in mongo
